login.tooManyAttempts: too many failed logins; try again later

memory.browsingHint: showing latest memories in {{container}} — type to search
memory.emptyContainer: no memories in this container yet
memory.degradedHint: partial results — some containers did not respond:
memory.notInitializedHint: image not initialized; run embed first
memory.score: Squared L2 distance; lower is better
memory.rerankApplied: Sorted by rerank relevance, highest first
memory.rerankUnavailable: Reranking unavailable; sorted by vector distance

usage.coldEndpoints: cold endpoints (low call volume — review for deletion)
usage.historicalError: Historical response body was not recorded (HTTP {{status}}). New errors retain redacted details.
usage.breakdown: Last 24h: {{api}} errors with API credentials; {{noise}} unauthenticated 404 responses (often scans or wrong URLs).

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.cancelHint: Only pending jobs can be cancelled. Running ingestion continues.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sessionHint: session TTL and lockout policy are set via env vars (TM_UI_SESSION_TTL, TM_UI_LOGIN_LOCKOUT_*). Restart the server to change them.
settings.serverHint: full version surface in /health JSON response

config.title: Configuration
config.subtitle: Tune how the memory service runs. Edits are staged on this page and only take effect after you press Save.
config.baseUrlHint: must point at the sanctioned gateway
config.invalidJson: invalid JSON — fix it before it can be staged

keyHint.routing_rules: JSON map of container name → routing rule overrides; {} inherits the defaults.
keyHint.global_enabled_map: JSON map of governance tool name → enabled flag.

config.footnote: Sensitive keys are write-only — the server never returns stored secrets. Live keys (similarity_threshold, citation_enabled) apply immediately; model/token keys persist now and take effect after the live reader picks them up.

moduleHint.rag: Retrieval & citation behavior — live keys apply without restart.
moduleHint.token: Per-day / per-hour token budgets and fallback model.
moduleHint.model: Gateway base URLs and API keys. Base URL writes are validated server-side.
moduleHint.dreaming: Background consolidation. The scheduler stays off until you enable it — fresh deploys add no autonomous work.
moduleHint.tools: Maintenance tool switches and sandbox limits. Tools support dry-run previews and real execution; destructive tools require confirmation before executing.
moduleHint.index_card: High-density index-card clustering knobs (placeholders until the tool consults them).
moduleHint.container: Container TTL, issue half-life and routing rules.

reason.rejected_base_url_host: base URL host not allowed (must be a sanctioned gateway)
reason.invalid_value_or_persist_failed: invalid value or failed to persist

dreaming.title: Dreaming
dreaming.intro: Off-hours consolidation that compacts and prunes memories. It writes only to the isolated governance store, never into your searchable containers.
dreaming.globalHint: The master switch and the background scheduler. The scheduler is off by default — turning it on is the only thing that adds autonomous work.
dreaming.triggerHint: Run one cycle now. Dry run only proposes candidates — it never deletes. A real run still needs the destructive-apply switch on.

tools.title: Governance tools
tools.intro: Per-container activation for maintenance tools. Safe tools (quota / latency reads, routing updates) run for real; LLM and destructive tools support dry-run previews and can also execute for real (LLM calls route via the gateway, destructive runs require confirmation).
tools.matrixHint: Each cell is the resolved switch (container override layered over the global map). Toggling a cell stages a container override saved via the config write path.
tools.globalConfigHint: Master switch map, sandbox memory cap, approval window and the default for newly added tools.
tools.okNoop: Nothing to do — no eligible targets (e.g. no cluster of 2+ memories).
tools.confirmBodyDefault: This will run the tool for real (dry_run=false).

confirmBody.snapshot_and_quarantine: Takes a container snapshot first, then moves low-value memories into quarantine (originals are not deleted). Reversible — restore from the snapshot / quarantine at any time.

full.title: Full capabilities
full.hint: Runtime checks reflect configuration; document status confirms actual ingestion.

documents.title: Document ingestion
documents.subtitle: Add full text, PDFs, images and documents to this container’s knowledge graph. Track processing and inspect parsed content here. Ordinary memory search stays on the Memory page.
documents.textPlaceholder: Paste the complete text to parse and retrieve…
documents.fileHint: PDFs, images, Markdown and Office documents. Maximum {{size}} MB per file; your public proxy may impose a lower limit.
documents.tooLarge: This file exceeds the server upload limit.
documents.queueHint: Submissions enter the background queue. The graph is ready only when the document status becomes Ingested.
documents.notReady: Ingestion or its background worker is not ready. Check the Overview capability status.
documents.enqueued: Job #{{id}} is queued; ingestion is not complete yet.
documents.unknownReceipt: The response was not confirmed. Check recent jobs before uploading again to avoid duplicates.
documents.jobsHint: A completed job has finished executing. The document library below shows the persisted ingestion status.
documents.empty: No matching documents. New jobs appear here after parsing starts.
documents.originalHint: This is the parsed content. Original uploads follow the existing cleanup policy and are not available for download.

knowledge.title: Knowledge graph
knowledge.subtitle: Explore entities and relationships extracted from documents, then ask questions grounded in ingested content. Queries use only the selected container.
knowledge.graphLabel: Zoomable entity graph with an accessible entity list alongside.
knowledge.entitySearch: Filter by entity name or description
knowledge.sampleHint: Showing {{nodes}} entities and {{edges}} relationships. Large graphs are sampled; counts cover the entire graph.
knowledge.askHint: Answers use parsed text, PDFs and images. Processing time depends on your model and graph size.
knowledge.question: Question
knowledge.questionHint: For example: What are the main devices and how are they related?
knowledge.waitHint: Retrieving the graph and generating an answer. Please wait.
knowledge.errorHint: The query was not automatically retried. Check service status before submitting again.
knowledge.noAnswer: No answer was returned. Check the status or rephrase your question.
knowledge.referencesHint: The server returned no structured citations. If the answer includes References, verify them against the source.
